task.instruction: Find all Uniqlo locations in Chicago, IL.

final_answer:
Google Maps lists three Uniqlo locations in Chicago, IL. Two are open and one is permanently closed.

1. **UNIQLO State Street**, 22 N State St. Phone +1 855-486-4756. It is closed now and opens at 10 am.
2. **UNIQLO Michigan Avenue**, 600 N Michigan Ave. Phone +1 855-486-4756. It is closed now and opens at 10 am.
3. **UNIQLO Chicago**, 830 N Michigan Ave. This one is **permanently closed**.

The website for all three is https://www.uniqlo.com/us/en/ The search covered the map area around downtown Chicago. The result list ended after these three, and Google Maps showed a limited view of the page.

judge.rationale: Google Maps search for “Uniqlo in Chicago, IL” shows three results and “You've reached the end of the list,” matching the agent’s listed locations.
